name: GitHub Actions Security Analysis with zizmor 🌈

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["**"]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  zizmor:
    name: Run zizmor 🌈
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      security-events: write # Required for upload-sarif (used by zizmor-action) to upload SARIF files.
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run zizmor 🌈
        uses: zizmorcore/zizmor-action@cc914d7f3750a2d13d75c7f184a1060aa0e9d482 # v0.6.4

name: Automation
on:
  pull_request: {}
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions: {}
jobs:
  types:
    name: Check types
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Set up cache
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "lts/*"
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Check types
        run: pnpm types

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Set up cache
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "lts/*"
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm exec biome ci

  build:
    name: Check that generated files are up to date
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Set up cache
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "lts/*"
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Build generated files
        run: pnpm build
      - name: Check for changes
        run: >
          if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ];
          then
            echo "Generated files are up to date."
            exit 0
          else
            echo "The files below have not been regenerated. Please run 'pnpm build' to fix this."
            echo "$(git status)"
            exit 1
          fi

name: Sync icons
on:
  # Allow workflow to be run manually
  workflow_dispatch: {}
  schedule:
    # Run at least once per week
    - cron: '20 2 * * WED'
permissions: {}
env:
  svg2xml_version: 1.0.2
jobs:
  types:
    name: Sync icons
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Set up cache
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "lts/*"
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Setup svg2xml
        run: |
          ./.github/workflows/scripts/svg2xml.sh ${{ env.svg2xml_version }}
          echo "$PWD/svg2xml-${{ env.svg2xml_version }}/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Sync icons
        run: pnpm sync:icons
        env:
          FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
      - name: Generate files
        run: pnpm build
      - name: Clean up
        run: rm -r svg2xml*
      - name: Create pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@5f6978faf089d4d20b00c7766989d076bb2fc7f1 # v8.1.1
        with:
          # CI won't run if we use the default GITHUB_TOKEN
          token: ${{ secrets.ELEMENT_BOT_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: Sync icons from Figma
          title: Sync icons from Figma
          body: New data is available from [Compound Icons](https://www.figma.com/design/gkNXqPoiJhEv2wt0EJpew4/Compound-Icons).
          branch: actions/sync-tokens
          delete-branch: true

name: Release npm package
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version-bump:
        description: The scale of the version bump required for semver compatibility
        required: true
        default: patch
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major
concurrency: release
permissions:
  id-token: write # Allow npm to authenticate as a trusted publisher
  contents: write # Allow creating a release
jobs:
  release:
    name: "Release & Publish"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 🧮 Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.ELEMENT_BOT_TOKEN }}
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: 📦 Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0

      - name: 🔧 Set up node environment
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "lts/*"
          cache: "pnpm"

      - name: 🛠️ Setup
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

      - name: 👊 Bump version
        run: |
          pnpm version --no-git-tag-version ${GITHUB_EVENT_INPUTS_VERSION_BUMP}
          pnpm format --write
          git config --global user.name 'ElementRobot'
          git config --global user.email 'releases@riot.im'
          git commit -am "${GITHUB_EVENT_INPUTS_VERSION_BUMP} version bump"
          git push
        env:
          GITHUB_EVENT_INPUTS_VERSION_BUMP: ${{ github.event.inputs.version-bump }}

      - name: 🚀 Publish to npm
        # We use npm directly for trusted publishing (provenance)
        run: |
          npm publish --provenance --ignore-scripts
          echo "VERSION=$(jq '.version' --raw-output package.json)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: 🧬 Create release
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9
        with:
          script: |
            const { VERSION } = process.env;
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;

            await github.rest.repos.createRelease({
              owner,
              repo,
              tag_name: `v${VERSION}`,
              name: `Release ${VERSION}`,
              body: `${VERSION} Release`,
              draft: false,
              prerelease: false,
            });

#!/bin/bash

# Exit early when any error is found
set -e

# Download
curl -L "https://github.com/element-hq/compound-svg2xml/releases/download/v$1/svg2xml-$1.zip" > svg2xml.zip
unzip svg2xml.zip
chmod +x svg2xml-$1/bin/svg2xml
